svg.title: The ProofMotion Algorithm Universe
svg.desc: An editorial map of implemented algorithms, graphics techniques, mathematical visualizations, and interactive workspaces in ProofMotion.
svg.text: Explore how algorithms, geometry and mathematical ideas become visible, step by step.

g.text: Edit the input. Follow each comparison, swap or search step.
Watch candidate edges, tree growth and traversal order.
Compare pixel choices; clip geometry to a viewing window.
Change pose and projection; compare the resulting geometry.
Move curve controls or explore a theorem proof, one step at a time.
Build a scene, transform it, then follow its graphics pipeline.

svg.text: ONE PLATFORM, MANY WAYS TO SEE THE LOGIC
Edit inputs · inspect intermediate states · scrub the trace · compare visual outcomes
Algorithms become easier to explore when every step can be seen.
